examples.en: This is my future husband.

examples.sr: Морамо да сачувамо природу за [бу̀дуће] генерације.
examples.en: We must protect nature for future generations.
Grandpa's eyesight keeps getting worse.
This is a perfective verb.

note: «поглед» is the word for a view from a window

examples.en: There are rats in the basement.
He's a real rat!
I got a flat tire on the road.
Do you have an eraser?

note: «гума за брисање» - eraser; «гума за жвакање» - chewing gum
tips: Гума is the tire, точак is the wheel: «Издувала ми се гума, морам да је напумпам» - my tire has gone flat, I need to pump it up.

examples.sr: Неко му је ставио [о̀тров] у пиће.
examples.en: Someone put poison in his drink.
This mushroom is pure poison.
Her eyes were full of tears.
We laughed until we cried.
What is your favorite dish?
Sarma is a traditional Serbian dish.

forms: попнем се, попну се; попео се; impf. пењати се

examples.en: We climbed to the top of the mountain.

examples.sr: [По̀пни] се на столицу и дохвати кутију.
examples.en: Climb up on the chair and reach the box.
It's snowing outside.
The kids are having a snowball fight in the snow.

examples.sr: После земљотреса у граду је владао [ха̏ос].
examples.en: After the earthquake, chaos reigned in the city.
My room is a complete mess.
The sun rises in the east.
We traveled east.
We don't have that many options.
Giving up is not an option.

examples.sr: Полиција мисли да је то било [самоуби́ство].
examples.en: The police think it was suicide.

examples.sr: Возити по овом снегу је право [самоуби́ство].
examples.en: Driving in this snow is real suicide.
Man is a social being.
All living beings deserve respect.

note: Not to be confused with «биће» - 'will be' (from бити)

examples.en: Slow down, you're driving too fast!
We need to slow the pace down a bit.
Turn off all electronic devices.
This device measures blood pressure.

related.en: to arrange, to put in order

examples.en: This is the last warning!
He paid no attention to the warnings.
She has nice full lips.
He bit his lip.

tips: Usually used in the plural: «суве усне» (dry lips), «кармин на усне» (lipstick on the lips). The singular «усна» is one lip.

examples.en: What happened? It's awful, just awful!
The party last night was awesome!

forms: предомислим се, предомисле се; impf. предомишљати се

examples.en: I changed my mind, I'm staying after all.
If you change your mind, let me know.
The bomb exploded in the city center.
My head is going to explode from work!
He kept his promise.

examples.sr: Не дај [обѐћања] која не можеш да испуниш.
examples.en: Don't make promises you can't keep.
Please hear me out.
The police will question the witnesses tomorrow.
Have you read today's newspaper?
Kids today are always glued to their phones.
The daughter adores her daddy.
Daddy will buy you an ice cream.
We're working on a new project.
The project has to be ready by Friday.
He is tall and strong.
A strong wind was blowing last night.
He has a great influence on her.
He was driving under the influence of alcohol.
You spend too much on clothes.
This car uses little fuel.
I'm too old for parties like that.

examples.sr: [Ма̀тори] ми не да ауто за викенд.
examples.en: My old man won't let me have the car for the weekend.
He ate half of the cake.
The second half of the movie is much better.
It's twenty degrees outside.
You're right to some extent.
Who runs this company?
He doesn't know how to steer a ship.
I love Chinese food.
He has been studying Chinese for two years.
Anyway, do whatever you want.
It doesn't really matter, after all.
Don't worry, it's just a phase.
The project is in its final stage.
Our friendship has lasted twenty years.
He values friendship above everything.

examples.sr: Овде нема места, хајде да седнемо [дру̏где].
examples.en: There's no room here, let's sit somewhere else.

examples.sr: Ако ти се не свиђа, потражи [дру̏где].
examples.en: If you don't like it, look elsewhere.
I go to work by bicycle.
They stole my bicycle last night.
He gave her a ring with a diamond.
They say diamonds are forever.
There isn't a single cloud in the sky.
Dark clouds mean rain is coming.

tips: Облак is masculine: мој облак, велики облак.

examples.en: My grandfather was an honorable man.
I give you my word of honor.

examples.sr: Ухватио сам неки [ви́рус], све ме боли.
examples.en: I caught some virus, everything hurts.
The computer got a virus.
He was a brave warrior.
The warriors were getting ready for battle.
The match was very exciting.
This is an exciting moment for me.
I don't accept your apology.
He never accepts criticism.

examples.sr: Да ли си ти [у̀мешан] у ово?
examples.en: Are you involved in this?

examples.sr: Полиција сумња да је [умѐшана] у крађу.
examples.en: The police suspect she is involved in the theft.
His dream became reality.
You have to face reality.
He won the swimming competition.
The competition starts at ten o'clock.
The customer is always right.
We have a lot of customers on weekends.

note: Feminine in form, even for a man: «стална муштерија»
tips: Often a regular customer known by sight: «мој муштерија». «Клијент» is more formal.

examples.en: Quick, call security!
He works in security at a shopping mall.
He came home after midnight.
See you at midnight in the square.
What is your position on this?
He has a positive attitude toward life.
The senator gave a long speech.
The journalist talked to the senator.

meanings: to hand over, to turn in

examples.en: She teaches math at a high school.
Okay, I give up!
Andrić is my favorite writer.
He always wanted to become a writer.
We need to have a serious talk.
Let's talk about it tomorrow.
She has a great talent for music.
That young man is a real talent.
I was born in March.
On March 8th we congratulate women.
On Saturdays I go shopping.
This apartment was a good purchase.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest in the world.
I have never seen the ocean.
You're a real jerk!
That bastard cheated me.
There are wild animals in the forest.
We saw a wild boar in the mountains.
Explain to me how this works.
The system isn't working the way it should.
She has a wonderful smile.
She greeted us with a smile.
It's in your interest.
He showed an interest in the job.
We live in the northern part of the country.
A cold north wind is blowing.
According to legend, a dragon once lived here.
He is a legend of Serbian soccer.
In the meantime it started to rain.
What were you doing in the meantime?

note: Usually in the phrase «у међувремену» - meanwhile

examples.en: This cake is exceptionally tasty.
He was extremely kind to us.
My throat has been sore since this morning.
I have a lump in my throat.
Filming of the movie starts in May.
The studio is booked for recording the album.
We live in Block 45 in New Belgrade.
He wrote the phone number in a notepad.
Please pass on my regards to him.
The match will be broadcast live on TV.
I almost fell down the stairs.
We almost missed the train.

note: «замало» + past tense, no «не»: «замало сам пао» - I almost fell

examples.en: An old cannon stands in front of the fortress.
They fired cannons all night.

tips: Colloquially also an indeclinable adjective, 'best, great': «Ово је топ филм». Not to be confused with «топ» - cannon.
Besides 'cannon', slang «топ» and «врх» mean 'awesome': «Торта је топ!»

examples.sr: Село је [уда̀љено] двадесет километара од града.
examples.en: The village is twenty kilometers from the city.
They live in a remote corner of the country.
The train enters a long tunnel.
You can see light at the end of the tunnel.

forms: усуђујем се, усуђују се; pf. усудити се

examples.sr: Како се [усу̀ђујеш] да ми то кажеш?
examples.en: How dare you say that to me?

examples.sr: Нико се не [усу̀ђује] да му противречи.
examples.en: Nobody dares to contradict him.
The election campaign lasts a month.
They launched a campaign against smoking.
Be careful while driving.
He is very considerate toward his mother.
The waves are too high for swimming today.
A new wave of flu arrives in December.
Children have a lot of activities after school.
Physical activity is important for health.

examples.sr: Мој брат је [у̀метнӣк], бави се сликарством.
examples.en: My brother is an artist, he paints.

examples.sr: Изложба младих [умѐтника] отвара се у петак.
examples.en: An exhibition of young artists opens on Friday.

note: Any kind of artist, not only a painter

examples.en: See you on Tuesday after work.
Every Tuesday I go to the pool.
She works for a charity.
Organizing the wedding took months.
What was his reaction?
I have an allergic reaction to strawberries.
Public transport is quite cheap.
We met in the city park.
You made that story up!
Who invented the telephone?
The health minister has resigned.
He met with the finance minister.
You should have seen his face!

examples.sr: Он је велика [фа̑ца] у овом граду.
examples.en: He is a big shot in this town.

tips: «Фаца» is not only a "mug": it is also a wealthy, cocky macho type. Compare «шмекер» - a charming ladies' man, «фрајер» - a cool guy (also a boyfriend).
Slang: «важна фаца» - a prominent, influential man, «светска фаца» - a man of the world; «шта је фаца!» - what an interesting guy!

examples.en: It's unusually warm today for December.
The kids are unusually quiet tonight.
Come here right now!
The doctor came immediately.
That was no coincidence.
What a coincidence, I'm going there too!
Press the button for the third floor.

examples.sr: Морамо мало да га [притѝснемо] да призна.
examples.en: We have to put a little pressure on him to make him confess.

examples.sr: Данас је баш [то̏пло], идемо на језеро.
examples.en: It's really warm today, let's go to the lake.
Dress warmly, it's snowing outside.
He is a famous actor from Belgrade.
All the actors came out on stage.
Don't talk so loudly, the baby is sleeping.
Read aloud what it says.
Which party won the election?
Let's play a game of chess.
Don't fire without my command!
The dog knows a few simple commands.
This room has no windows at all.
Smoking is prohibited on all premises.
I forgot to water the plants.
This plant likes a lot of sun.

forms: интересујем, интересују; интересовати се за + acc.

examples.en: I don't care what other people think.
I'm interested in history.

tips: «Интересовати се» takes «за» + acc.: «интересујем се за српску културу» - I'm interested in Serbian culture.

examples.en: Don't pay any attention to him.
He always addresses me formally.
Do you have any idea at all?
He left without any reason.
You look sad today.
It's sad that it happened.
Buy some bread and milk.
I like warm bread with butter.
They sell all sorts of things at the market.
She has been to various places.
You're going in the wrong direction.
What's your major?
The winner gets a cash prize.
Everybody loves winners.
The books are on the bottom shelf.
The neighbors from the floor below are noisy.
Remind me to buy bread.

examples.sr: Ова слика ме је [подсѐтила] на детињство.
examples.en: This picture reminded me of my childhood.

note: «подсетити» + acc. «на» + acc.: «подсетио ме је на тебе»

examples.en: That was my lifelong dream.
The standard of living keeps rising.
I remember our first meeting well.
He came out to meet the guests.

note: «изаћи у сусрет» - to go to meet; to accommodate

examples.sr: Не могу себи да [приу̀штим] нов ауто.
examples.en: I can't afford a new car.
Let's treat ourselves to a vacation.
Oh no, I forgot my keys!
Woe is me, what will I do now?

tips: Expresses pain or fear: «Јао, шта сам урадио!» - oh, what have I done!
Stronger and sharper than «јој»: pain, fear, shock, almost a cry. «Јао, шта си урадио?!» - What have you done?!

examples.sr: То је само [и̏згово̄р] да не дођеш.
examples.en: It's just an excuse not to come.
Your pronunciation is almost perfect.
I was completely confused.

examples.sr: [Збу̀њена] девојка није знала шта да каже.
examples.en: The bewildered girl didn't know what to say.

forms: приближавам се, приближавају се; pf. приближити се

examples.en: Winter is slowly approaching.
We're nearing the end of the road.
We had a big fight last night.

examples.sr: Код комшија је сваког дана нека [сва̏ђа].
examples.en: There's some quarrel going on at the neighbors' every day.
The door is locked from the inside.
The house is much bigger on the inside.

examples.sr: То је био тежак [перѝод] мог живота.
examples.en: That was a difficult period of my life.

examples.sr: У том [пѐриоду] сам живео у Нишу.
examples.en: During that period I lived in Nis.
See you tomorrow at noon.
He slept until noon.
Is this seat free?
The company's headquarters is in Belgrade.

forms: потрудим се, потруде се; impf. трудити се

examples.en: I'll try to arrive on time.
You need to try a bit harder.
I'm not your servant!
The servant brought dinner.

note: Masculine, but declines like a feminine noun: слуге, слугу

examples.en: Hold on tight!
I firmly believe he will succeed.

examples.sr: После [ра̀звода] преселила се у Нови Сад.
examples.en: After the divorce she moved to Novi Sad.
She is asking her husband for a divorce.
This smells disgusting.
I caught a terrible cold.
How far does this bus go?
How long are you going to keep behaving like this?
Smoke is coming out of the kitchen.
The room is full of smoke.

related.en: to smoke, to give off smoke

examples.en: Grandpa has a farm in the countryside.

examples.sr: Продали су [има́ње] и преселили се у град.
examples.en: They sold the estate and moved to the city.
The fox stole a chicken.
The policeman put handcuffs on him.

note: In the plural, «лисице» also means handcuffs

examples.en: Mom is making an apple pie.
I took a piece of cheese pie.
Don't provoke me!
Smoking causes cancer.
Hello, who is this?
Hello, can you hear me?
They buried him in his home village.
Where is your grandfather buried?
They live in the western part of the city.
Western Serbia is known for its mountains.

meanings: to burst in, to barge in

examples.en: Don't barge into the room without knocking!
He's always getting into trouble.
That's a completely natural reaction.
This juice is made from natural ingredients.
The doctor referred me to a specialist.
They set off toward the border.
I'm reading a great novel.
She wrote her first novel.

note: Only a book; a romance in real life is «веза» or «авантура»

examples.en: Cooking is a real skill.
In the course we learn new skills.
I completely agree with you.
The house has been completely renovated.
He reported the theft of a car.
He was arrested for theft.
He found out that she has a lover.
They were lovers for years.
That's complete nonsense.
You have my full support.
The younger generation thinks differently.

examples.sr: Кућа је у породици већ три [генѐрације].
examples.en: The house has been in the family for three generations.
You mustn't hit your younger brother.
The boys were fighting in the yard.
That was an act of real courage.
He holds the rank of colonel.
This is a holy place.
Saint Sava is the patron saint of schools.

tips: Besides 'world': «има света» - there are plenty of people, «цео свет» - everybody; «светлост» - light (illumination).

examples.en: The cause of the fire is still unknown.
What is the cause of the problem?
Can you describe the attacker?

examples.sr: Не могу речима да [опѝшем] колико сам срећан.
examples.en: I can't describe in words how happy I am.
Tomorrow I have a checkup at the doctor's.
This is a brief news summary.
He was sentenced to five years in prison.

examples.sr: Немој да га [осу̀диш] пре него што га чујеш.
examples.en: Don't judge him before you've heard him out.
We're going to a concert on Saturday.
The concert started late.
We don't have enough people.
That's reason enough for me to leave.

tips: In school grades, 2 is «довољан» (sufficient, a bare pass), 1 is «недовољан» (fail), 5 is «одличан» (excellent).

examples.en: I hate commercials during a movie.
I saw an ad for a new phone.
He took a hard blow to the head.

examples.sr: Деда је прошле године имао мождани [у̏да̄р].
examples.en: Grandpa had a stroke last year.
A package from Germany has arrived for you.
We got an internet and TV package.

tips: «Откупни пакет» - a cash-on-delivery parcel. «Пакет» - a small parcel or package, «пошиљка» - any postal item, «писмо» - a letter.

examples.en: Don't blame me for that!
He's always blaming others for his mistakes.
The fence is made of barbed wire.
A string on my guitar broke.
I don't like that at all.
He hasn't changed at all.

note: Used with a negative: «нимало није тешко» - it isn't hard at all

examples.en: I heard a rumor that you're moving.
I don't believe those rumors.
We have a small garden behind the house.
The zoo is open until six.

tips: «Зоолошки врт» - zoo. «Врт» - a garden; «башта» - a garden or vegetable plot, also a café terrace. «Повртњак» - vegetable garden, «воћњак» - orchard.

examples.sr: Остали смо без речи пред [лепо̀том] планина.
examples.en: We were speechless before the beauty of the mountains.
Beauty isn't the most important thing.
He is a computer expert.
We'll ask some expert.
I enrolled in an English course.
What's the euro exchange rate today?
The Russian tsar lived in St Petersburg.
Thanks, you're the best!

note: colloq. «ти си цар» - you're the best
tips: Used as praise: «Баш си цар!» (to a woman «царица») - you're the best, a real master, respect for help or an achievement.

examples.en: We accepted his proposal.
The genitive is used after the preposition 'without'.

tips: Besides 'proposal', it is also the grammatical preposition («у», «на», «са»): «Који падеж иде уз овај предлог?» - Which case goes with this preposition?

forms: осумњичена, осумњичено; as a noun: осумњичени

examples.en: The suspect was arrested last night.
He is suspected of theft.
Water is essential for life.
You don't have to come.
The swallows are flying low, it's going to rain.
The picture hangs too low.
We're going to the museum on Sunday.

examples.sr: Улаз у [му̀зеј] је бесплатан за студенте.
examples.en: Museum admission is free for students.
She had strange visions in her dreams.
The director has a clear vision for the company's development.
A bear lives in this forest.
The child sleeps with a teddy bear.
He grew a long beard.

examples.sr: Пао је и ударио се у [бра̑ду].
examples.en: He fell and hit his chin.
This recipe is very simple.
He's a simple man.
Young people are leaving the village.
Don't leave me, please!

meanings: to serve (a purpose), to come in handy

examples.en: Please help yourselves!

examples.sr: Ова кутија ће нам [послу́жити] за селидбу.
examples.en: This box will come in handy for the move.
Friday is my day to go out.
We watched the sunrise over the sea.

note: «излаз» is the exit (the place), «излазак» is the act of going out

examples.en: We rented an apartment downtown.
We have to hire a good lawyer.

examples.sr: Плави [ки̏т] је највећа животиња на свету.
examples.en: The blue whale is the largest animal in the world.
We saw whales from the ship.
She has kept a diary since childhood.
We watch the news at half past seven.

tips: A pupil's school report book with grades is «ђачка књижица»; at school, «дневник» is the teacher's class register.

examples.en: The prosecutor is asking for twenty years in prison.
I spoke with the prosecutor.

tips: «Тужилац» is both the prosecutor and the plaintiff in a civil case. The defendant is «тужени», not «туженик».

examples.en: He stopped in the middle of the street.
He woke up in the middle of the night.
There are many old trees in the park.
The trees have already blossomed.

note: Collective singular: «дрвеће је зелено» (the trees are green)

examples.en: I have training every day at six.
After training I'm always hungry.
Write the name in capital letters.
The Cyrillic alphabet has thirty letters.

note: A letter of the alphabet; a word is «реч»
tips: «Слово» is a letter («реч има седам слова» - the word has seven letters); a word is «реч». «Ово слово се тешко пише» - this letter is hard to write.

examples.en: You are the pride of our family.
He swallowed his pride and apologized.

tips: Pride: «имам понос због успеха» - I take pride in my success.
«Понос ми је што си ту» - I'm proud that you're here. «Поносан» - proud.

examples.en: Wait for me in the hotel lobby.
Leave your jacket in the hallway.
Come here, my dear!

examples.sr: [Ми̏ло] ми је што смо се упознали.
examples.en: Nice to meet you.

note: «мило ми је» - nice to meet you

examples.en: Serbia is divided into districts.
He is the sheriff of this county.
You're in a really good mood today.
I'm not in the mood for jokes.

examples.sr: У последње време сам под великим [стре̏сом].
examples.en: I've been under a lot of stress lately.
This job stresses me out.

meanings: to fall silent, to shut up

examples.en: Just shut up already!
When he came in, everyone fell silent.
He does hard physical work.
Physically he's strong, but mentally weak.
This party is a real disaster.
The earthquake caused a disaster.

tips: Often used as a reaction to a minor annoyance: «Боли ме глава - катастрофа!» It can be said ironically.

examples.en: I eat one apple every morning.
The apple pie is ready.

tips: Feminine: «моја јабука», «слатка јабука».

examples.en: Music is his greatest passion.
There is no passion left between them.
